projects.name: Arabic Customer-Complaint Classification
projects.description: Prepared 180,000 Arabic customer-complaint tweets by stripping diacritics and elongation, removing duplicates, and tokenizing into sub-word pieces. Labelled 3,000 tweets by dialect with two other assistants and measured inter-annotator agreement. Adapted a pretrained Arabic transformer encoder to classify complaints into nine topics, improving Macro-F1 from 0.71 (bag-of-words baseline) to 0.86. Tracked experiment settings and results in a spreadsheet for reproducibility.
